[01] Who it is for

Built for the teams that carry the context.

01

Operations and finance

Month-end close, payout rules, refund approvals: the procedures that must run the same way every time, whoever or whatever runs them.

02

Support and success

Pricing policy, what we promise, what we never promise. Answers that are the same in the help desk, in Slack and in ChatGPT.

03

Leadership and data

Goals, definitions and the numbers behind them. Churn means one thing, and every dashboard and every agent agrees.

[02] What changes

Before and after.

Before

  • The real procedure lives in someone's head, a Slack thread and three stale docs.
  • Two agents give two numbers for churn.
  • An agent quietly rewrites a page and nobody notices for a month.

With Atlas

  • One page per procedure, with a version and a name on it.
  • Every agent answers from the same definition.
  • Agent edits arrive as change requests a person approves, and everything is in the audit log.
